base.description: The seat of Solarian government and commerce. Everything here is certified, warrantied, and documented in triplicate — from the precision drydocks to the quantum-entangled trade exchange. A self-sustaining biosphere spans three decks, providing real air and real food, because the Confederacy believes civilization requires both.
base.name: Confederacy Central Command

condition.condition_text: Multiple systems running on emergency reserves. Lights flicker in the corridors.
